snippet.title: Village Tale - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A relaxing real-time idle village-building simulator nestled in the corner of your screen! Build, Craft, and Trade to guide your village from humble beginnings to a thriving trading hub, it's time to write your own Village Tale!

Play the playtest on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447510
